newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C. Bank cuts refinancing rate to 36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia C. Bank cuts refinancing rate to 36 pct.

text.p: Russia's Central Bank is cutting its refinancing rate to 36 percent with effect from April 28 from the 42 percent in force since February 10, spokesman Alexei Sitnin told Reuters on Thursday.
Sitnin gave no reason for the rate cut.
But inflation has been continuing to slow. On Wednesday the State Statistics Committee said the monthly price rise would be 1.3 percent in April on current price trends after 1.4 percent in March.

The Central Bank does not actually use the refinancing rate as the basis for a lending facility to commercial banks, but the rate is used in contracts and as the basis for many commercial bank rates. It has an important signal effect.
On Tuesday Central Bank chairman Sergei Dubinin said the bank aimed to cut the refinancing rate to about 25 percent over an unspecified period.
The central bank is also cutting the rate on its Lombard lending facility to commercial banks from April 28.
The rate on 8-14 day loans will fall to 30 from 33 percent, and the rate on 15-30 day loans will fall to 36 from 42 percent. The rate on 3-7 day loans remains unchanged at 24 percent.
